title: Daniel and the Lions

memoryVerse.text: God is with you wherever you go.

moral.lesson: Daniel kept praying to God even when it was scary and even when it got him thrown into a den of lions. God did not leave Daniel alone — He sent an angel and kept him safe all night long. God was with Daniel in the very scariest place.
moral.application: When you feel afraid — at night, at a new school, or when something hard happens — you are never alone. God is with you, just like He was with Daniel.

style: Flat-color children's cartoon storybook illustration, simple rounded shapes, soft warm colors, thick clean black outlines, bright and friendly, gentle lighting, 16:9 landscape composition, no text or words in the image, no letters.

beats.scene: Daniel, a kind man with a short grey beard wearing a long blue robe, stands smiling in a grand palace room while the king in a red and gold robe with a crown speaks warmly to him.
text: Daniel loved God very much, and he worked for the king.
Daniel did such a good job that the king wanted to put him in charge of the whole kingdom!

beats.scene: A group of jealous royal officials in fancy robes whisper together in a palace hallway, looking sneaky and unhappy, plotting.
text: But some of the other leaders were jealous of Daniel.
They made a sneaky new rule: for thirty days, no one could pray to anyone except the king.
Anyone who did would be thrown to the lions!

beats.scene: Daniel, the kind man with a short grey beard in a long blue robe, kneels peacefully in prayer by an open window with warm sunlight streaming in, looking calm and trusting.
text: Daniel heard about the new rule. But he still went to his window,
got down on his knees, and prayed to God — just like he always did.
Daniel would not stop talking to God.

beats.scene: Daniel, the kind man with a short grey beard in a long blue robe, sits calmly in a dim stone den surrounded by several big friendly-looking lions who are resting quietly. A soft warm glow of light shines around him.
text: So Daniel was thrown into the den of lions.
The king was very sad, but God had a plan.
God sent an angel to shut the lions' mouths, and the lions did not hurt Daniel at all!

beats.scene: Morning sunlight pours into the open lion den as the happy king in a red and gold robe helps Daniel, the kind man with a short grey beard in a long blue robe, climb safely out. Both are smiling with relief and joy.
text: In the morning, the king ran to the den and called out, “Daniel! Are you okay?”
“My God sent His angel and kept me safe!” Daniel answered.
God was with Daniel the whole time. And God is always with me.
